question: Should inquiry be caused for one who has entered?
premises: Entry of one entered should not cause inquiry.
One established in worldly conduct, however.
When such one has entered, he is that.
inference: No inquiry should be caused for one entered; worldly-established one is such when entered.
plain_english: For one who has entered, inquiry should not be caused; but one established in worldly conduct, when such a one has entered, he is that.
